o.text: From Old Anatolian Turkish رهبر (rähbär), from Persian رهبر (rahbar).

Calque of Russian нетрадиционной ориентации (netradicionnoj orijentacii, “of non-traditional [sexual] orientation”).
By surface analysis, qeyri-ənənəvi orientasiya + -lı.
From yarım + fabrikat. Calque of Russian полуфабрика́т (polufabrikát).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یرلو یرنده (yẹrlü yẹrinde). By surface analysis, yerli + yerində.
